reason: When I'm having hot samosas with 4 PM chai, I need chutney on the spot from the mithai shop or Blinkit, not via courier after 3 days.
objection: Why order online and wait 2 to 3 days when I can grab sauce from the local kirana or make it at home?
would_change_my_mind: Stock it on Blinkit or Zepto so I can get it in 10 minutes when chai arrives.
